title: How the NDIS works, start to finish
hook: New to the NDIS? Here's the whole journey.
ig:
New to the NDIS? Here's the whole journey, from applying to your first support.

1. Apply. Call the NDIA on 1800 800 110 for an access request form.
2. The NDIA decides if you can join.
3. Your planning meeting. Talk about your needs and goals.
4. You get your plan.
5. Choose a provider, sign a service agreement, and start.

Save this, and send it to someone just starting out.

Questions? Call The Health & Well-being Hub on 0433 604 507. We reply within 2 business hours.
tt: The whole NDIS journey in 5 steps. Save this for later.
review: Compliance review: NDIA phone number, the 21-day decision aim, and the steps.

title: Your child isn't being moved off the NDIS today
hook: Seen the headlines about kids and the NDIS?
ig:
Seen the headlines about kids and the NDIS? Here's what actually changed.

If your child is already on the NDIS, their plan and supports stay. The rules for young children joining the NDIS don't change until January 2028.

Thriving Kids is for children 8 and under with developmental delay or autism and low to moderate needs. No diagnosis needed.

Questions? Call the Thriving Kids Autism Helpline.

Send this to a parent who's worried.
tt: Is your child being moved off the NDIS? Not today. Here's what changed.
review: Compliance review. Check every line against the Thriving Kids pages and confirm the helpline before posting.

title: Under $1,500? You don't need to ask
hook: Still waiting for approval to buy an $89 shower chair?
ig:
Still waiting for approval to buy an $89 shower chair? You might not need it.

If it's low-cost, low-risk equipment under $1,500, you don't need a quote, an assessment or approval first. It comes from the consumables part of your Core budget. Keep the receipt.

Not sure if it's low-risk? Ask before you buy.

Questions? Call The Health & Well-being Hub on 0433 604 507. We reply within 2 business hours.
tt: Under $1,500 and low-risk? You may not need approval first.
review: Compliance review. Check the $1,500 threshold on the official page on the day you post.

title: Carers need a break too
hook: When did you last get a full night's sleep?
ig:
When did you last get a full night's sleep? Caring is a 24-hour job.

Short Term Accommodation can be funded in an NDIS plan. The person you care for has a short stay, with support. They get new experiences. You get time to rest.

Ask about it at your next plan meeting.

Taking a break isn't giving up. It's how you keep going.

Send this to a carer who needs it.
tt: Carers need a break too. Ask about Short Term Accommodation.
review: Compliance review. Say 'can be funded', never 'will be'. No dollar amounts.

title: Your plan isn't final. You have 3 months
hook: Got an NDIS decision you don't agree with?
ig:
Got an NDIS decision you don't agree with? You have 3 months to ask for a review.

Step 1: ask for an internal review. The NDIA aims to decide within 60 days.
Step 2: still disagree? You can go to the Administrative Review Tribunal, within 28 days.

Say what's wrong, and why. Add any evidence you have.

Free disability advocacy services can help you.

A plan letter is a decision. Not a full stop.
tt: Don't agree with your NDIS plan? You have 3 months to ask for a review.
review: Compliance review. General information, not legal advice.

title: Don't go to your planning meeting alone
hook: Walking into your NDIS meeting alone?
ig:
Walking into your NDIS meeting alone? You don't have to.

You can bring a family member, a friend, an advocate or your support coordinator. They can take notes, remember what you forget, and speak up when it's hard to.

Just remind them to bring ID.

Two memories are better than one.

Send this to someone with a meeting coming up.
tt: Never go to your NDIS planning meeting alone.
review: Compliance review. Confirm the ID requirement is still current.

title: You're not stuck with your provider
hook: Think you're stuck with your provider?
ig:
Think you're stuck with your provider? You're not.

You choose your providers, and you can change them. Check your service agreement for the notice period, then give notice. Then choose someone who fits: your language, your culture, your needs.

Your plan. Your choice.

Questions? Call The Health & Well-being Hub on 0433 604 507. We reply within 2 business hours.
tt: You can change your NDIS provider. Here's how.
review: Check against H&W's own service agreement. Keep the tone helpful, not competitive.

title: Your NDIS can help you get a job, and keep it
hook: Want to work, but don't know where to start?
ig:
Want to work, but don't know where to start?

Your NDIS plan can include support to find and keep a job. Like help to build job skills, get to work, and settle in once you're there.

And remember: getting a job won't cancel your NDIS.

Ask about it at your next plan meeting.

Send this to someone ready to work.
tt: Your NDIS plan can help you find a job and keep it.
review: Compliance review. Confirm current employment support rules before posting.

title: Plan-managed? You may have more choice than you think
hook: Do you know how your plan is managed?
ig:
Do you know how your plan is managed? There are three ways: agency-managed, plan-managed or self-managed.

Right now, if you're plan-managed or self-managed, you can also use providers who aren't NDIS-registered. These rules tighten from 2027 for higher-risk supports, so always check before you book.

At H&W, we accept all three.

Know your plan type. It changes who you can choose.

Questions? Call The Health & Well-being Hub on 0433 604 507. We reply within 2 business hours.
tt: Agency, plan or self-managed? It changes who you can choose.
review: Compliance review. Say 'right now'. Keep 'we accept all three' word for word.

title: Who unties the knot? Support coordinators
hook: You've got an NDIS plan. So why does it feel like this?
ig:
You've got an NDIS plan. So why does it feel like a knot?

A support coordinator's job is to untangle it. They explain your plan line by line, find providers who fit you and book them, help fix things when they break, and show you how it all works so you can do more yourself.

Look in your plan for Support Coordination. If it's there, use it.

Talk to us in English, Arabic, Somali, Dari or Amharic. Questions? Call The Health & Well-being Hub on 0433 604 507. We reply within 2 business hours.
tt: What does a support coordinator actually do?
review: Compliance review. Say 'if Support Coordination is in your plan'.

title: Your community budget could be cut in half
hook: Does your NDIS plan pay for classes, outings or social groups?
ig:
Does your NDIS plan pay for classes, outings or social groups?

From October 2026, funding for social and community activities is being cut in half. Funding to build daily living skills drops by 10%.

It doesn't happen overnight. It changes when your plan is reassessed or renewed. Until then, keep using your plan as normal. The NDIA says it will contact you about 60 days before a renewal.

Other parts of your plan are not part of this change.

Questions? Call The Health & Well-being Hub on 0433 604 507. We reply within 2 business hours.
tt: NDIS community funding is being cut in half. Here's when it hits your plan.
review: Compliance review: funding claims (50% and 10%), timing and the 60-day notice.

title: The 90-day rule
hook: Got a pile of NDIS invoices you'll claim later?
ig:
Got a pile of NDIS invoices you'll claim later? From December 2026, later has a limit.

Supports must be claimed within 90 days of the day they happen. It used to be two years. It's the same for every plan type.

Self-managing? Claim every week or two. Plan-managed? Send invoices to your plan manager as they arrive.

Ninety days goes faster than you think. Claim early.

Send this to someone who self-manages their plan.
tt: New NDIS rule: claim within 90 days or miss out.
review: Compliance review: the 90-day rule and its start date.

title: A conversation, not a computer
hook: Worried a computer will decide your NDIS plan?
ig:
Worried a computer will decide your NDIS plan? Here's what's actually coming.

From April 2027, people start moving to a new way of planning. It includes a support needs assessment: a guided conversation with a trained assessor, at a time and place that works for you. You can bring family, a carer or a support person.

Your plan is still approved by trained NDIS staff. People, not computers. You'll hear from the NDIA before anything changes for you.

Send this to someone worried about the NDIS changes.
tt: Will a computer decide your NDIS plan? No. Here's what's coming in 2027.
review: Compliance review: new planning dates and the support needs assessment.

title: Help with the shopping, not the shopping
hook: Can your NDIS plan pay for groceries? Rent? Your power bill?
ig:
Can your NDIS plan pay for groceries? Rent? Your power bill?

No. Those are everyday living costs, and the NDIS doesn't pay for them. That includes rent, groceries, power, water, phone and internet bills.

The NDIS pays for supports linked to your disability, like a support worker who helps you shop, a therapist, or equipment you need.

Not sure if something counts? Ask before you spend.

Questions? Call The Health & Well-being Hub on 0433 604 507. We reply within 2 business hours.
tt: What the NDIS won't pay for (and what it will).
review: A human must approve the examples of what the NDIS pays for.

title: Registered means checked
hook: Is your NDIS provider registered?
ig:
Is your NDIS provider registered? And what does that mean?

Registered providers are checked by the NDIS Quality and Safeguards Commission. They are audited, and their workers must pass a screening check. From July 2026, Supported Independent Living and online platform providers must be registered. And if the NDIA manages your plan, you can only use registered providers.

You can check any provider on the Commission's online register.

The Health & Well-being Hub is a registered NDIS provider (4050045262).

Registered means checked. Look before you book.
tt: Is your NDIS provider registered? Here's why it matters.
review: Compliance review. Shows H&W's registration number.

title: Only you can ask
hook: Your needs have changed. Who can ask the NDIA to look at your plan again?
ig:
Your needs have changed. Who can ask the NDIA to look at your plan again?

Since August 2026, only you can ask. Or your plan nominee, or your guardian. Your provider can't ask for you. Your support coordinator can help you get ready, but the request comes from you.

It's for changes that are big, and that will last. Write down what changed, and when. Keep reports and letters.

Your plan. Your request.
tt: Needs changed? Only you can ask for your NDIS plan to be looked at again.
review: Compliance review: who can ask for an unscheduled reassessment, and when.

title: Read it before you sign it
hook: About to sign a service agreement with a new provider?
ig:
About to sign a service agreement with a new provider? Check three things first.

1. What you'll get, and what it costs.
2. How much notice you need to give to cancel a visit.
3. How to end the agreement if it doesn't work out.

Don't understand something? Ask. You can take it home and read it first.

Read it before you sign it.
tt: 3 things to check before you sign an NDIS service agreement.
review: Check against H&W's own service agreement.

title: Plan renewal? Come prepared
hook: Got a message that your NDIS plan is being renewed?
ig:
Got a message that your NDIS plan is being renewed? Use the time before your meeting well.

Gather your latest reports from therapists and doctors. Write your goals in your own words: what do you want to do this year? Write down what worked, and what didn't. And ask your support coordinator to help you get ready.

A renewal is a chance to be heard. Come prepared.

Send this to someone with a plan renewal coming up.
tt: NDIS plan renewal coming up? Do these 4 things first.
review: None needed beyond a final read.

title: You can ask for that
hook: Would you feel more comfortable with a support worker who is a woman? Or a man?
ig:
Would you feel more comfortable with a support worker who is a woman? Or a man? You can ask for that.

It's your home, and your care. Who helps you matters. Tell your provider what you need, right at the start.

At H&W, gender-matched workers are available on request.

Questions? Call The Health & Well-being Hub on 0433 604 507. We reply within 2 business hours.
tt: You can ask for a female (or male) support worker.
review: Kholoud approves the framing.

title: Plans change. Just give notice.
hook: Need to cancel a support visit at the last minute?
ig:
Need to cancel a support visit at the last minute? It could still cost you.

If you cancel at short notice, a provider can charge up to the full price, if your service agreement says so. Your service agreement says what counts as short notice. Check it.

If you have to cancel, tell them as early as you can.

Plans change. Just give notice.
tt: Cancelling an NDIS support last minute? It could cost you.
review: Check against H&W's cancellation terms.

title: Your NDIS plan can open more doors
hook: Got an NDIS plan? It can open more doors than you think.
ig:
Got an NDIS plan? It can open more doors than you think.

It can help with daily life, like support at home or help with meals. It can help you learn new skills, get out to classes, sport and friends, and find a job and keep it. It can also help with equipment, or changes to your home, that make life easier.

You choose who supports you, even someone who speaks your language.

What's in your plan depends on your goals and needs. So tell your planner what you want to do.

Your plan isn't just support. It's opportunity.

Questions? Call The Health & Well-being Hub on 0433 604 507. We reply within 2 business hours.
tt: Your NDIS plan can open more doors than you think.
review: Compliance review: what a plan can help with. Keep 'can', never 'will', and that it depends on goals and needs.
